name: Rock Paintings of Shulgan-Tash Cave
description: Deep in the Southern Ural Mountains of Bashkortostan, Shulgan-Tash Cave is a limestone cavern whose walls carry Ice Age paintings in red ochre. Hundreds of metres from the entrance, mammoths, rhinoceroses, bison, horses and a rare two-humped camel appear. Discovered in 1959, they showed that cave art was not confined to Spain and France.
